sql:
SELECT OpenDate 
FROM schools 
WHERE GSoffered = 'K-12' 
ORDER BY Enrollment DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT OpenDate 
FROM schools 
WHERE GSoffered = 'K-12' 
ORDER BY Enrollment DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(s.OpenDate) AS First_Open_Date
FROM frpm
JOIN schools s ON frpm.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.School Type = 'K-12 Schools (Public)'
ORDER BY frpm.Enrollment (K-12) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    MIN(schools.OpenDate) AS First_Open_Date
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.School Code = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    frpm.School Type = 'K-12 Schools (Public)'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.Enrollment (K-12) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(s.OpenDate)
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.School Name = 'District Office'
AND f.[Enrollment (K-12)] >= CAST(500 AS REAL)
AND s.OpenDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    frpm.School Name,
    frpm.OpenDate
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.School Code = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    frpm.School Name = 'District Office'
    AND frpm.Enrollment (K-12) >= CAST(500 AS REAL)
    AND schools.OpenDate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    frpm.Enrollment (K-12) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(s.OpenDate) AS OpenDate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools s ON frpm.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.School Name = 'District Office'
AND frpm.Enrollment (K-12) >= 500
AND s.OpenDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Enrollment (K-12)] IS NOT NULL AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
ORDER BY f.[Enrollment (K-12)] DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.OpenDate
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.High Grade = '12'
ORDER BY 
    f.Enrollment (K-12) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.School Type LIKE '%K-12%'
ORDER BY f.[Enrollment (K-12)] DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(OpenDate)
FROM schools
WHERE School IN (
    SELECT School
    FROM frpm
    WHERE LowGrade = 'K' AND HighGrade = '12'
    ORDER BY Enrollment (K-12) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
